description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pennithawa, Ihalagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420949 (23/55060)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it concerns property ownership, land titles, and registration processes under the Registration of Title Act.
